property.name: errorFileUploadIsRequired
property.description: Error shown when document upload is required but nothing was uploaded
property.label: File Upload is Required Message

property.name: errorFailedToAttach
property.description: Error shown when document fails to be attached
property.label: Upload Failed Error Message
property.default: There was an issue attaching your file.

property.name: errorFailedToDelete
property.description: Error shown when document fails to be deleted
property.label: Delete Failed Error Message
property.default: We were unable to remove this file.

property.name: acceptedFormats
property.description: Comma separated list of accepted formats, e.g. '.pdf,.docx'
property.label: Accepted Formats

property.name: allowMultiple
property.description: Indicates if multiple files can be attached
property.label: Allow Multiple Files
